title: MDungeons Paintings Data Pack
description: Adds paintings from Minecraft Dungeons to Minecraft
body:
This datapack adds paintings from Minecraft Dungeons most of which are portraits of developers from the titles of the game. It includes 79 paintings, which are presented in sizes:
- 1x1 — 2 paintings
- 2x1 — 1 painting
- 2x2 — 6 paintings
- 2x3 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)
- 3x2 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)
- 2x4 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)
- 3x3 — 58 paintings
- 4x4 — 1 painting
- 16x9 — 7 paintings (new minecraft painting size)
- 11x16 — 1 painting (new minecraft painting size)

In order for the paintings to be displayed correctly, you also need to download the [resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/minecraft-dungeons-paintings-resource-pack) for this datapack.
